Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building ages, sizes, classrooms, and specialized spaces; detailed condition assessments including roofs, HVAC, plumbing, and accessibility; uses multiple data sources including facility audits and roofing manufacturer assessments; connects condition data to student outcomes and long-term capital planning (Pages 6-7, 21-27).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections over 6 years with methodology from SchoolWorks, Inc.; includes capacity utilization data by site and classroom; connects enrollment trends to facility actions including boundary adjustments and project prioritization; considers new housing developments and TK expansion (Pages 6-7, 14-24).

Educational Alignment.justification: Plan references district mission and educational goals as guiding principles; connects facility projects to educational programs such as CTE, TK, and science labs; includes some discussion of programmatic shifts and instructional priorities but coverage is partial and not fully integrated as a core organizing principle (Pages 6-7, 12-13, 35-37).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Mentions outdoor learning spaces and playground improvements; includes some references to outdoor play in LCAP goals and community input; lacks detailed data or districtwide analysis of green spaces, shade coverage, or greening strategies (Pages 6, 12).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related challenges broadly (e.g., safety, air quality improvements) but does not provide detailed climate risk assessments or comprehensive mitigation strategies; no evidence of climate readiness as a central theme (No explicit detailed climate risk assessment found).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Mentions energy efficiency projects such as HVAC replacements funded by ESSER; references some energy-related upgrades but lacks comprehensive data on energy use, resilience strategies, or references to state mandates like Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals (Pages 32-33).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a detailed capital strategy with itemized project costs, phased implementation plan, and prioritization criteria; identifies multiple funding sources including local bonds, state modernization funds, developer fees, and reserves; includes financial projections and fund balances over 8 years (Pages 8-10, 28-33, 50-56).
